summary: Building on Bei Yi's beiyi-ten-parent-cover-t039 submission, this contribution tightens the rational enclosure of the window functional using a higher-degree cosine polynomial bound. The lower-bound numerator is increased by one unit at a denominator of 10^50, yielding a strictly improved exact rational critical-line proportion bound. The original window coefficients, pair weights and coverage certificate remain unchanged. All three required theorem statements were privately verified using Lean and Nanoda. Developed with AI assistance.
method: Ten-point parent-cover method with refined rational window-functional enclosure
